title: The zones' Flash flags: res/field/flash/flash.json
description: The one file of ARCID_MAPEFF_SKILL_TBL (a/1/4/9): the zones that GetZoneFlashFlags in zonedata.c finds a zone's Flash flags in, the first entry of the zone's; a zone that isn't listed has neither flag. GameData_UpdateFlashStatus gives the zone's flags to the field (FieldStatus_SetFlashPerms), and a zone with neither makes the game forget that Flash was used (ZoneChange_OnMapChange). tools/data/flash_data.py packs it.

zone.description: The zone, by its ZONE_* constant

allow.description: Whether Flash can be used in the zone (FLD_FLASH_ALLOW in include/field/field_status.h), which becomes active once it has been

active.description: Whether the zone is lit as if Flash had been used (FLD_FLASH_ACTIVE)
